records.title: 10-Q
records.text: In the three months ended March 31, 2023, we generated $221.0 million in total revenue.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The revenue mix for the three months ended March 31, 2023 was: cloud subscriptions 26%; software license 2%; maintenance 16%; services 53%; and hardware 3%.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Our international revenue was approximately $72.7 million for the three months ended March 31, 2023, respectively, which represents approximately 33% of our total revenue for the three months ended March 31, 2023.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Our R&D expenses were $30.8 million for the three months ended March 31, 2023.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: For the three months ended March 31, 2023, we generated cash flow from operating activities of $58.7 million.
